versos.texto_bv: Não basta você ter nos tirado de uma terra que mana leite e mel para nos matar no deserto? Ainda quer exercer domínio absoluto sobre nós?
versos.traducao_literal: É pouco que nos fez subir de uma terra que mana leite e mel, para fazer-nos morrer no deserto, que também se faça senhor sobre nós, fazer-se senhor?
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): “exercer domínio absoluto” adiciona o qualificador “absoluto” que não está no original (hebraico ‘sarar’ = governar/príncipe) — evidência: ARA: “fazer-te príncipe sobre nós”; NVIPT: “se fazer chefe sobre nós”; NTLH: “querer mandar em nós”. Nenhuma das três referências emprega “absoluto”. A correção para “exercer domínio sobre nós” (sem “absoluto”) exigiria mudança de sentido (remoção de intensificador presente na BV).

kjv.texto: Is it a small thing that thou hast brought us up out of a land that floweth with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, except thou make thyself altogether a prince over us?

vizinhos.12: And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab: which said, We will not come up:
vizinhos.14: Moreover thou hast not brought us into a land that floweth with milk and honey, or given us inheritance of fields and vineyards: wilt thou put out the eyes of these men? we will not come up.

web.texto: Is it a small thing that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, but you must also make yourself a prince over us?

vizinhos.12: Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab; and they said, “We won’t come up!
vizinhos.14: Moreover you haven’t brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor given us inheritance of fields and vineyards. Will you put out the eyes of these men? We won’t come up.”

versos.texto_bv: A terra abriu a boca e os engoliu, junto com suas casas, todas as pessoas ligadas a Corá e todos os seus bens.
versos.traducao_literal: E abriu a terra sua boca, e engoliu a eles e suas casas, e todo o ser humano que era de Corá, e todos os bens.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): “casas” traduz bayit literalmente, mas o sentido contextual é “famílias”/“casas” como metonímia de households — evidência: NTLH: “famílias”; ARA: “famílias”; NVIPT: “famílias”. A correção para “famílias” exigiria mudança de sentido (interpretação da metonímia), ultrapassando o escopo de forma.

kjv.texto: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their houses, and all the men that appertained unto Korah, and all their goods.

vizinhos.31: And it came to pass, as he had made an end of speaking all these words, that the ground clave asunder that was under them:
vizinhos.33: They, and all that appertained to them, went down alive into the pit, and the earth closed upon them: and they perished from among the congregation.

web.texto: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up, with their households, all of Korah’s men, and all their goods.

vizinhos.31: As he made an end of speaking all these words, the ground that was under them split apart.
vizinhos.33: So they, and all that belonged to them went down alive into Sheol.  The earth closed on them, and they perished from among the assembly.
